chips.title: Run the bounded three-arm continuation diagnostic
chips.summary: Compare native resume, compiled prompt and TORC capsule on two historical tasks with every attempt retained. An apparatus check, not an effectiveness study.

evidence.message: Recorded retroactively from the git log and the 2026-10-21 results record; the work landed on master as PR 35 before this chip existed.
Eight admissions ran (two seeds, six comparisons) with no paid API. Two of six comparisons passed the frozen gate, so there is no ranking and no savings claim.
Where both portable arms passed, the TORC capsule reported 44% more input tokens than the compiled prompt. One pair on one workload, not a population effect.

chips.title: Collect eight real interrupted tasks across three repositories
chips.summary: Preserve starting trees, history and acceptance checks for naturally stopped work. The operator kept the eight-task gate over a smaller pilot.

evidence.message: Recorded from the 2026-10-21 execution plan: the operator chose to keep the eight-real-task requirement and collect more cases first.
Six candidate records across three repositories are preserved and none is admitted, so the eight-task gate is unmet and the later study stages wait.
The repo shows no collection work after 2026-10-21 and the plan installs no watcher. Cases must come from naturally stopped work, not manufactured pauses.
